items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI is out now on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S
items.summary: GTA VI is out now worldwide on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. It unlocks at midnight local time, starting in New Zealand.
items.body: Grand Theft Auto VI launched on November 19 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, unlocking at midnight local time around the world, starting in New Zealand. On PS5, Sony's required system software update has to be installed before you can play. On Xbox One and Series X|S the game can also be streamed through Xbox Cloud Gaming.

items.title: GTA VI reviews land with a 99 on Metacritic
items.summary: GTA VI is getting near-perfect reviews and is tied with Ocarina of Time as Metacritic's highest-rated game.
items.body: Reviews for Grand Theft Auto VI are in, with 10/10 from both GameSpot and IGN and 5/5 from Eurogamer, The Guardian and Bloomberg. GameSpot reports that this puts the game level with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time as the highest-rated game of all time on Metacritic. Review scores are press reports, not confirmed by Rockstar.

items.title: GTA VI nears 25 million copies and $2.36 billion on day one, Sensor Tower estimates
items.summary: Sensor Tower estimates 24.58 million copies and about $2.36 billion through launch day, about 75% on PS5. Rockstar and Take-Two haven't confirmed any figures (not confirmed).
items.body: Sensor Tower estimates that Grand Theft Auto VI reached 24.58 million units through pre-purchases and launch-day sales, worth about $2.36 billion in gross revenue. 18.44 million of those copies are on PS5 and 6.15 million on Xbox Series X|S. Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick said the company will share official sales data soon; these figures are not confirmed.

items.title: Rockstar shows GTA VI's rebuilt weather in six new screenshots
items.summary: Rockstar gave The Weather Channel six new screenshots, presented as a forecast for Leonida, from sea fog to a tropical storm.
items.body: Rockstar Games shared six new Grand Theft Auto VI screenshots through The Weather Channel, written up as an in-character forecast for Leonida with heavy rain in the Keys, a storm over Pelican Valley, sea fog at South Ocean Beach and a tropical storm at the Rusty Anchor. Rockstar's Owen Shepherd, VP of art for light and rendering, says the team had to "completely reimagine" its weather systems to feel "more localized, persistent, and above all dynamic." The game launched November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

items.title: First look at "Macca & Friends", an in-game TV show on Weazel
items.summary: A first teaser shows Macca the Gator and his wetland friends. The show came to Weazel in GTA VI on November 19.
items.body: Rockstar shared the first look at "Macca & Friends," an in-game TV series about a sunglass-wearing pink gator and his wetland friends across Leonida. The teaser sets up a story in which Macca needs money to pay his landlord, Pinchie the crab. The show came to the in-game network Weazel on November 19.

items.title: GTA VI is the most pre-ordered game ever on PlayStation Store and Microsoft Store
items.summary: Sony and Microsoft both call GTA VI their biggest pre-order of all time. The game unlocked at midnight local time on November 19, country by country.
items.body: Sony says Grand Theft Auto VI is now the most pre-ordered game in PlayStation Store history, and Microsoft calls it the most pre-ordered title of all time on the Microsoft Store. Neither company shared a figure. On PS5, the game unlocked in a rolling midnight launch by country, starting at 12:00 a.m. NZDT in New Zealand on November 19.

items.title: Take-Two: Rockstar has completed development of GTA VI
items.summary: On Take-Two's November 9 earnings call, CEO Strauss Zelnick said Rockstar has finished developing GTA VI and that pre-orders are tracking far above expectations. No pre-order numbers were given.
items.body: "Right now, Rockstar has completed the development of GTA VI," Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick said on the company's November 9 earnings call. Take-Two says pre-orders are "continuing to reach unprecedented levels" and are tracking far in excess of its initial expectations, but it didn't share a figure. The launch remained November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

items.title: GTA VI's roads are significantly narrower than GTA V's
items.summary: Rockstar's Aaron Garbut says GTA VI's roads were made much narrower on purpose, for denser traffic and more buildings.
items.body: Rockstar's Aaron Garbut told Bloomberg's Jason Schreier that the roads in Grand Theft Auto VI were deliberately made much narrower than in GTA V. According to Garbut, this leads to denser traffic and leaves more space for buildings to fill the world.

items.title: Rockstar spent years trying to replace the weapon wheel
items.summary: Bloomberg's Jason Schreier says Rockstar tested trays, webs and other layouts for GTA VI's limited, Red Dead-style loadouts before going back to a classic weapon wheel.
items.body: According to Bloomberg reporter Jason Schreier, Rockstar spent a long time testing alternatives to the weapon wheel for Grand Theft Auto VI. The experiments, including trays, webs and other layouts, were meant to support more limited, Red Dead-style loadouts. Rockstar reportedly returned to a classic weapon wheel in the end.

items.title: GTA VI Launch Trailer is out
items.summary: Rockstar released the official Launch Trailer, featuring "Flower in a Hurricane". Release remained November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
items.body: Rockstar Games has released the official Launch Trailer for Grand Theft Auto VI. It debuts "Flower in a Hurricane" by Justice feat. Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, from the game's original score. The release date remained November 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

items.title: Bloomberg goes inside the making of GTA VI
items.summary: In a Bloomberg Businessweek cover story, Rockstar's leads talk about the two delays and the 2022 leak, and say the next game won't take another eight years.
items.body: Rockstar has grown from 2,441 people in 2018 to 4,711 across 12 studios, according to the report. Studio lead Phil Hooker says "the game is never completely settled" and that the new engine, tools and team should make the next game faster to build. Rockstar rejects the widely cited $1.5 billion budget figure.

items.title: First six radio stations revealed
items.summary: Rockstar previewed six in-game stations, including Flash FM, Cocoteo FM and Back Country Radio, plus on-demand podcasts.
items.body: Rockstar Games has previewed the first six radio stations of Grand Theft Auto VI, including Flash FM, Cocoteo FM and Back Country Radio. The game also gets on-demand podcasts, and radio and podcasts can be heard on foot with headphones too.

items.title: Xbox Cloud Gaming streams GTA VI at launch
items.summary: Xbox Cloud Gaming streams GTA VI on consoles from day one. The deal is not exclusive and doesn't include PC.
items.body: The Verge reports that Xbox Cloud Gaming streams Grand Theft Auto VI on consoles at launch. The story was later corrected: according to Xbox, the deal is not exclusive and streaming to PC is not included.
